summary: MetalKit is Apple's Metal helper layer: a view that owns a drawable loop (MTKView), a texture loader, and Model I/O mesh wrappers. BifrOSt now has device-free models for the texture loader's options and mip chains and for mesh containers (layout, buffers, submeshes, bounds, buffer budget). It still has no app-facing GPU view, no GPU texture object and no device-backed mesh buffers.

features.note: Presenter is internal to the shell. SDK views are retained CPU views; no app-facing GPU render view or per-frame draw delegate
GBM and EGL drawables exist in the system layer; apps get no device or drawable API

features.apple: MTKTextureLoader (newTexture URL, data, cgImage; asset catalog), MTKTextureLoader.Option
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/texture.rs (LoadOptions, TextureDescriptor, mip_layout, generate_mips, apply_origin, prepare, load_bytes); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (decode, PNG and JPEG)
features.note: Load options (sRGB, allocate and generate mipmaps, origin, usage, cache and storage hints), descriptors, mip chains and box-filtered mip generation are pure and tested. Decoding stays on the CPU. Missing: a GPU texture object, asynchronous load, asset catalog lookup, cube layouts and the display gamut

features.feature: Model I/O mesh handling (MTKMesh, MTKSubmesh, MTKMeshBuffer, allocator)
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/mesh.rs (VertexLayout, Buffer, BufferAllocator, Submesh, Mesh, Aabb)
features.note: Mesh containers with validated vertex layout, one buffer per stride, submeshes with index buffers, index range checks, position bounds and a byte-budget allocator. Pure CPU data. Missing: device-backed buffers, asset loading from files, normal and tangent generation, subdivision, attribute add and replace, and format conversion

features.apple: (no direct MetalKit class; Metal draw calls)
features.note: Internal batching of shell primitives into one vertex list per frame. Not exposed to apps

features.apple: Conversion Functions (Metal and Model I/O vertex layouts), Model Errors
features.note: Depends on Model I/O, which BifrOSt does not have

gaps: No app-facing GPU view with a per-frame delegate (MTKView and MTKViewDelegate equivalent) in springboard/sdk/src/
No GPU texture object or asynchronous texture loading; springboard/render/src/texture.rs prepares pixels and descriptors but nothing uploads them to the device
No asset catalog lookup and no cube texture layouts for the texture loader
No device-backed mesh buffers; springboard/render/src/mesh.rs owns CPU bytes only
No mesh loading from asset files and no normal, tangent or subdivision generation
Presenter (springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs) is shell-internal; its Metal-shaped API has no SDK binding
The GPU stack is GLES on GBM and EGL, not Metal; a Metal-shaped API is only a design note in docs/gpu-first.md
